purpose: Teach: 固く/ちょこっと/ガム/スプーン/風船/古本/はれ/ゴロゴロ

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 最近、関節が固くなってきたな、私の体。
lines.en: My joints have been getting stiff lately.
lines.style: Slow, patient observation. Soft exhale on the opening. Gentle acceptance rather than complaint — the tone of someone used to noticing his own aging without making a show of it.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん。お薬、ちょこっとだけ、飲むのよ、忘れずに。
lines.en: Yes. Just remember to take your medicine, won't you.
lines.style: Practical gentleness. A light, knowing tone — she's said this before and will say it again. Warm without fussing. Small pause before 'won't you' like she's tucking the reminder in carefully.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 入れ歯の調整、ガム、噛んでみても、いいのかな?
lines.en: I wonder if it's alright to chew gum while I'm adjusting my dentures.
lines.style: Genuine curiosity, almost childlike. He's asking without self-consciousness. Slight upturn at the end, genuinely wondering aloud to her. Not worried — just figuring something out together.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 銀のスプーン、孫に、贈ろうかしらね。
lines.en: Maybe I should give my silver spoon to one of the grandchildren.
lines.style: Drifting thoughtfulness. Spoken as if she's turning the idea over in her mind as she speaks. Tender underneath — thinking about what will outlast her. Quiet, not sad.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 昔、お祭りで、風船、いっぱい買ってやったな、息子に。
lines.en: You know, I used to buy him so many balloons at the festival when he was small.
lines.style: Warm nostalgia. A slight smile in the voice. The memory settles on him gently — he's not stuck in it, just visiting it. Slow, unhurried pace. The voice of someone who's made peace with time passing.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 本棚の古本、整理しないとね、いつか。
lines.en: I really should sort through all those old books on the shelf one of these days.
lines.style: Soft, matter-of-fact. No urgency. The tone of someone making a note to herself as much as to him. A small sigh underneath — not complaint, just the weight of small tasks that accumulate. Trailing off slightly.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 明日、はれてくれると、散歩、行けるな。
lines.en: If the weather clears up tomorrow, I could take a walk.
lines.style: Quiet possibility. A gentle hopefulness — not expecting much, but noticing what might be. Measured pace. The voice of someone learning to find small satisfactions in small things.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 最近、家でゴロゴロして、運動不足だわ、私。
lines.en: I've been lazing around the house so much lately — my fitness has really suffered.
lines.style: Dry, self-aware humor. A light rueful tone — she's teasing herself. Not complaining, just observing her own laziness with wry affection. Quick delivery, then a beat of acknowledgment.
